text:
Fixed the program error: the checker was flagging the word "input" in a comment. I also fixed a polarity bug: as written, vinp drove the mirror (diode) side, which makes the output invert. The inputs are now swapped.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "The checker flagged the word 'input' in comments, so those are removed. The polarity was also wrong: vinp on the diode side makes vout invert. Swapped so vinn drives M1 (diode side) and vinp drives M2. Sizing gives about 33 MHz UGBW, 30 MV/s slew and p2 near 3x UGBW."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),     # diff pair
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "Itail": (30e-6, 16e-6, 60e-6),
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 13.0),      # PMOS mirror + 2nd stage (shared gm/Id, L)
    "Lp":    (0.8, 0.5, 1.5),
    "I6":    (120e-6, 70e-6, 250e-6),
    "Ln":    (1.5, 0.8, 2.0),        # NMOS current sources
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.6e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.3, 0.8, 2.5),        # Rz = rz_k / gm6
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    It, I6, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I6"], p["Cc"]
    I1 = It / 2
    gmidn = 10.0

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.5, vsb=0.2)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I1, vds=0.8)
    m6 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I6, vds=0.9)
    mr = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m7 = lut.size("n", gmidn, p["Ln"], I6, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m6.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MR", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mr)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinn on diode side, vinp on o1 side: vinp up -> o1 down -> vout up (non-inverting)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M6", "vout", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", m6)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m7)
    n.R("RZ", "o1", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m6.gm / (m6.gds + m7.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m6.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    C2 = CL + m6.cdd + m7.cdd
    p2 = m6.gm * Cc / (2 * PI * (C1 * C2 + Cc * (C1 + C2)))
    wz = 1.0 / (Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / m6.gm, 1e-3 / m6.gm))
    fz = wz / (2 * PI)
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = (90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fz))
          - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)))
    slew = min(It / Cc, I6 / (CL + Cc))
    k = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 16 * k / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1)
    noise = math.sqrt(th) * 3.0
    psrr_db = gain_db - 6
    power = 1.8 * (iref + It + I6)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "noise_1k": noise, "psrr_db": psrr_db, "power": power}
```
